items.quote: And Moses spake unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which the LORD commanded, saying,
items.claim: The text says Moses spoke to the whole congregation of the children of Israel and passed on a command he credited to the LORD. Passes 1 and 2 both support this.

items.quote: Take ye from among you an offering unto the LORD: whosoever is of a willing heart, let him bring it, an offering of the LORD;
items.claim: The text says the offering was to be collected from among the people and given only by those 'of a willing heart', which makes it voluntary rather than required. Passes 1 and 2 both support this.
items.mechanism: voluntary giving by those of a willing heart

items.claim: The first materials listed for the offering are the metals gold, silver and brass. Only pass 1 has this, but the document states it word for word.

items.quote: And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats’ hair, 35:7 And rams’ skins dyed red, and badgers’ skins, and shittim wood,
items.claim: The offering also included dyed materials (blue, purple, scarlet), fine linen, goats' hair, rams' skins dyed red, badgers' skins and shittim wood. Only pass 1 has this, but the document states it word for word.

items.quote: And oil for the light, and spices for anointing oil, and for the sweet incense,
items.claim: The offering included oil for the light and spices for the anointing oil and the sweet incense. Only pass 1 has this, but the document states it word for word.
items.mechanism: materials for lighting, anointing oil and incense

items.quote: And onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod, and for the breastplate.
items.claim: The offering included onyx stones and stones to be set in the ephod and the breastplate. Only pass 1 has this, but the document states it word for word.
items.mechanism: materials for the ephod and breastplate
